Hi Alice / Bob -

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap + the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (attached). Below are the POC environment milestones we discussed and proposed owners. Please confirm or flag changes so we can lock timelines.

POC milestone: Environment setup (dependencies) - target completion: 2026-04-08
- VPC peering / network connectivity - Owner: Acme (network) / Redwood to provide peer IPs and peering instructions by 2026-03-24
- IP allowlists / firewall rules - Owner: Acme; Redwood to provide egress IPs and port list (TLS, 443) by 2026-03-24
- SSO / SAML integration + SCIM provisioning - Owner: Acme (IdP) + Redwood (SAML metadata & test user); target: SAML metadata + test user by 2026-03-29
- Secrets / KMS - Owner: TBD (Acme preferred BYOK or Redwood-managed KMS). Decision and initial policy by 2026-03-26
- Test credentials and smoke test plan - Owner: Redwood (SE) to provide test plan; Acme to run and confirm by 2026-04-01

Dependencies / blockers:
- VPC peering requires Acme to approve peering request and provide VPC ID + subnets.
- If BYOK for KMS is chosen, we'll need key ARN and access policy earlier (by 2026-03-26).
- SAML metadata + SCIM settings needed for automated user provisioning during the POC.

Next steps:
1) Please review attached MAP_Draft_v1 and the milestone owners above.
2) Alice/Bob: confirm if Acme will use BYOK for KMS or allow Redwood-managed key.
3) Share VPC IDs and any existing peering constraints by 2026-03-24.

I've attached the MAP draft and a network diagram for reference. I'll follow up with a brief engineering note from Nikhil outlining exact network fields we'll need.

Thanks - looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa

Bob - thanks, great questions. Short answers and owners below.

KMS options (decision needed by 2026-03-26):
- Option A (recommended for speed): Redwood-managed key for the POC. No BYOK required; Redwood will maintain the key and grant access scoped to the POC environment. Owner: Redwood (security).
- Option B (BYOK): Acme provides AWS KMS key ARN and an access policy. If you choose BYOK, we'll need the key ARN and an IAM policy snippet; Dev will send the exact policy template. Owner: Acme (security).

SAML / SCIM:
- Redwood supports SAML 2.0. We can provide SAML metadata URL or XML. We also support SCIM v2 for provisioning; however SCIM is optional for initial POC. Owner: Acme to provide SAML metadata + optionally enable SCIM.

Network / VPC peering details (Redwood action items):
- We will provide the peer IP ranges, target ports, and a step-by-step peering guide by EOD 2026-03-24.
- Nikhil (copied) will include exact subnet/CIDR requirements and recommended NAT/firewall rules.

I've updated the MAP draft to show Redwood as owner for the managed-key path and included the BYOK step as an alternate. See attached updated page 2.

Action items (owners):
- Acme: Decide KMS approach and share SAML metadata (deadline 2026-03-26) - Alice/Bob
- Redwood: Provide peer IPs, port list, and IAM policy template if BYOK chosen (deadline 2026-03-24) - Marissa / Nikhil / Dev

Let me know if you want a quick 20-min sync to make the KMS decision.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa - forwarding a quick note I drafted for Acme (feel free to paste into the thread). We need the following from Acme to complete the peering and firewall config:

Required from Acme for VPC peering / allowlist:
- VPC ID(s) + region
- CIDR blocks and subnets to be peered (include AZs if possible)
- Public egress IPs (if traffic is NAT'd) or the specific NAT gateway IPs
- Any proxy/firewall that will perform TLS interception - if present, we need cert TTL/inspection rules
- Contact window for peering (date/time) and a technical point-of-contact

If Acme chooses BYOK for KMS, we also need:
- KMS key ARN
- Key policy allowing Redwood roles: policy template below (we will provide the exact JSON)
